payload.name: Monolithic Review-Loop Complexity Accumulation
payload.description: Concentrating review iteration orchestration, CI check inspection, reviewer adjudication, and resolver routing in a single monolithic module (sandbox_executor/flow/review/loop.py) degrades testability and triggers module line-budget and ruff complexity failures.
symptoms: Ruff complexity violations (C901, PLR0912, PLR0913, PLR0915) during lint checks
Module line-budget violations reported against holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json
High mocking overhead and brittle regression tests when changing one review-loop stage
root_causes: Adding new CI polling, finding triage, or resolver branches inline inside loop.py instead of dedicated helper modules
Passing broad multi-concern state dictionaries through deeply nested loop functions
Mixing I/O coordination with pure adjudication and routing decisions

mitigations.description: Split orchestration, CI inspection, adjudication, and resolver routing into single-responsibility modules under sandbox_executor/flow/review/.
Keep functions within C901 <= 10, PLR0912 <= 12, PLR0913 <= 5, PLR0915 <= 50 and respect holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json without inline noqa suppressions.
